thread:
Ivy P: Hey team  my corporate card was used to buy a virtual conference ticket (EventHub Pro) but I actually purchased two tickets accidentally: one on corporate card and one on my personal card because the promo code failed. Ramp shows the corporate charge but the vendor says they can only issue a partial refund to the corporate card and a credit to my email. I need to get reimbursed for the personal charge and make sure we don't double-pay.

Derek S: @Ivy P  can you DM me the transaction screenshots and the personal card receipt? Also paste the vendor's refund confirmation here when you get it.

Ivy P: Uploaded screenshots and email: vendor confirms refund of $250 to corporate card and a store credit $250 to my personal email (no auto-refund possible due to promo rule). Personal charge was $250 USD.

Finance Bot: Note: If the vendor issues a credit to a personal card or account, Finance can process a manual reimbursement for the out-of-pocket charge after manager approval and verification of docs. Please include manager approval and bank last4 for ACH.

Derek S: Approved for reimbursement of $250 (Derek S). Ivy please provide bank last4 and attach the personal card statement line showing the charge.

Ivy P: Bank last4: 1199. Uploaded personal card statement and vendor email (store_credit.png). Ramp expense: https://app.ramp.com/expenses/REDACTED/5543  I also left a note: "Vendor issued store credit to personal email; please reimburse."

Monica Y: Quick policy check  conference registrations are reimbursable up to $1500 with pre-approval. Since you used a personal card for the duplicate charge and have manager approval, we'll reimburse. For tax: if vendor cannot provide VAT invoice, expense treated as non-reclaimable. Do you have VAT on the invoice?

Ivy P: Invoice shows VAT 0% (US vendor). No VAT.

Treasury: Initiating manual reimbursement flow FIN-2026-788. Please confirm desired payout method (ACH ad-hoc or include in next payroll). ACH typically 2 business days.

Ivy P: Please ACH to bank last4 1199. Thanks.

Finance Bot: FIN-2026-788 created and assigned. Docs attached. Expected ACH in 2 business days after approval.

(Next day)

Treasury: ACH initiated for $250 USD to bank ending 1199 ref PAY-2026-901. Note: we recorded the vendor store credit as company-owned credit; we'll use it for future conference purchases and not reimburse again.

Ivy P: Received ACH today, thanks. Small follow-up: vendor told me if we want the store credit transferred to Redwood account we need to provide company billing email. Someone want to claim that credit for future events?

Derek S: I'll claim it for the team  send the vendor the company billing email ops-billing@redwood.ai and forward the vendor's confirmation so they can reassign.

Monica Y: FYI policy update suggestion: add a short note to travel & events doc about duplicate ticket buys and store credits  how to escalate. I can draft and send to finance-docs.

Finance Bot: FIN-2026-788 status: Closed.

Ivy P: All good, closing thread  thanks everyone :raised_hands:
